entities.summary: Ustad Farida Mahwash ; is an Afghan singer and voice of Afghanistan. She was the first woman to have been conferred the honorary title of "Ustad" in 1977. She currently lives in Fremont, California, US; and tours the world with her latest ensemble, "Voices of Afghanistan".
